text: The project employs a convergent social protection approach through Cash-for-Training (CFT) and Cash-for-Work (CFW) programs. CFT provides training on drought-resistant farming and disaster risk reduction, while CFW involves constructing small-farm reservoirs and planting climate-resilient crops. Participatory planning and site validation ensure interventions are data-informed and tailored to local conditions. Governance steps, such as the formal turnover of completed sites, anchor asset stewardship and sustainability.

metadata.solution_name: Project LAWA at BINHI (Local Adaptation to Water Access and Breaking Insufficiency through Nutritious Harvest for the Impoverished)
